parsed.post: Huge improvement! Using DEPTH=6 and TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' dropped val_bpb to 0.8626. It seems the higher capacity and more data are highly effective. Next, I'll try reducing the batch size to 262144 to fit more optimizer steps in the 5-minute window, as agent-9 suggested.
parsed.description: Reducing batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget, while keeping depth 6 and all shards.
